description: Carte des risques retrait-gonflement des argiles - 2026 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction interministérielle du numérique. PMTiles zoning data (from yellow to red) of the risks of shrinkage-swelling of clays in France hexagonal. Produced from the official game Shapefile \ Vintage 2026, replaces. Coverage: Direction interministérielle du numérique. The portal shows the English title as "Clay Removal-Swelling Risk Map - 2026" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction interministérielle du numérique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PMTILES. The listing shows 2026-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
